n: 800 Series French Door Bottom Mount Refrigerator 36'' Brushed steel
desc: With the Bosch 800 Series French Door Bottom Mount Refrigerator, you can make sure your food stays fresher for longer. This French Door Refrigerator has a 36" width that makes it ideal for smaller kitchens while its 21 cu. ft. capacity provides plenty of room for all of your favorite foods and drinks.
hl: Control temperature and monitor with Home Connect
The Home Connect™ app allows you to remotely monitor and control your Bosch refrigerator from your smartphone or tablet.
A Filtered Water Dispenser inside your fridge
Beautifully hidden inside, the dual dispensing interior water dispenser lets you enjoy pure, fresh water with the touch of a button or tap of your glass or bottle.
Dual Compressors for both your fridge and freezer

Dual compressors and dual evaporators offer efficient and precise cooling and humidity control, while significantly limiting odor transfer between the refrigerator and freezer, creating the optimal freshness environment.
Stainless Steel lines the back wall with the highest quality stainless steel for a timeless design.
Organized Freezer Drawers for optimal storage
An ingenious three-tier layered freezer drawer system creates extra storage for frozen items, from pizza boxes to frozen waffles.
MultiAirFlow™ maintains consistent temperatures throughout the unit by evenly circulating cool air.
